comparison.title: There's more than one way to build it.
comparison.subtitle: Here's how the options compare.

me.name: Custom development
me.description: Software and automations built around how you already work — with the code, infrastructure, and ownership staying with you.
me.descriptionShort: Built around how you work. Code and ownership stay with you.

inhouse.name: Hiring in-house
inhouse.description: A strong long-term investment, but slower to get started and expensive before the team is fully up and running.

agency.name: Development agency
agency.description: Reliable and scalable, but typically more expensive and less direct — you're often one step removed from the person building it.
agency.descriptionShort: Reliable, but pricier — and you're a step removed from the builder.

nocode.name: No-code tools
nocode.description: Fast and inexpensive to start, but limited when your needs grow — and you're dependent on the platform behind it.
nocode.descriptionShort: Fast and cheap to start, limited once your needs grow.

manual.name: Keeping it manual
manual.description: Nothing to build upfront. But the cost keeps adding up in time, repetition, and missed opportunities.
